entities.summary: Anthony Christopher Clark is an American former professional baseball player and union leader. He played in Major League Baseball as a first baseman from 1995 to 2009 and was the sixth executive director of the Major League Baseball Players Association (MLBPA), a position he held from 2013 to 2026.
